name: com.origuma.easypbr-urp
description: Stylized PBR + Toon hybrid character shader for the Universal Render Pipeline. Designed for figure/doll-like characters, with automatic face self-shadow fixing, decoupled cast/receive shadows to avoid toon-edge banding, dual-lobe specular with energy conservation, and optional SSS / Rim / Peach Fuzz / MatCap effects.
